failure_modes: Selecting a narrower or broader teacher neighborhood (C004/C005/C006) without intact-teacher dispersion or joint-geometry evidence would change mode coverage and could displace surrounding coordinates while providing no demonstrated affinity benefit; neighbor count is not a distance bandwidth.

Selecting a temporal_teacher_blend (C007/C008/C009) would alter teacher coordinates/regional attention at observed score nodes based on an unresolved H001 comparison, risking unnecessary coordinate displacement under a coordinate reward that is not a validated affinity predictor.

Changing pointcloud_delta_A (C001/C002/C003) would alter distance-response curvature without observed spatial-scale or uncertainty support, and could be misread as a physical interaction-energy change when it is only an untyped coordinate proxy.

Treating the nonnegative excess-distance audit metric or survival/last-record credit as final affinity benefit would misdirect the affinity-first objective, since terminal labels lie outside the observed window and ancestral coverage is sparse.
rationale: The Analyst's delivered evidence does not license any registered bounded edit. All contrast evidence is confined to the observed score window [0.0,0.5] (E0857891f4effbfe1), and the curve-support selection rule is an enrichment criterion (absolute integrated z >= 0.1, batch-direction fraction >= 0.857, q < 0.05) rather than an absolute geometric descriptor (Ed4e7d28e7b0423e0); no continuous contrast curve values, sign changes, fit fidelity or rate changes were read, so H001's time-conditioned-versus-constant comparison is unresolved. The information audit explicitly states its metrics are not the full score-weighted reward or its FLOWR Jacobian and that excess distance is nonnegative by construction rather than a causal affinity effect (E2bb8390452ed517a), so no dose, curvature or spatial-emphasis change can be justified from it. Lineage support shows sparse ancestral coverage (349 nodes <3 ancestors, 531 <6) and survival credit that is explicitly not terminal affinity effect (Ed0d7945bdeeda8f1), and terminal labels lie outside the observed window, so H002's direction-priority revision is unavailable rather than resolved. With the objective being final predicted target affinity primary (Eaa4bda02c9a2c3a1) and no current-study outcome data supplied, none of the offered choices (pointcloud_delta_A, teacher_neighbors, temporal_teacher_blend) has a defensible expected advantage over the incumbent D2_without_trajectory_static (pointcloud_delta_A=1.0, teacher_neighbors=4, static reward view). Retaining the incumbent is therefore the evidence-supported decision; the fixed temperatures (mixture_temperature 0.5, teacher_endpoint_temperature_A2 4.0) are immutable and untouched.
